About

I study how systems fail so I can help build ones that don't.

At UTS that means a cybersecurity and networking major, with Python, C/C++, machine learning and data science picked up along the way. The rest of the week I teach kids to code at Code4Fun. Demos like the one above are how I explain things to ten-year-olds, and they work on adults too.
